text:
Oliver: quick idea — propose a 'slim-fastpath' for the embeddings ingress to avoid full preflight for tiny, consistent-dim requests. should cut ~30-50ms p50 on host path. only enabled when client sends explicit X-Embed-Dims header and payload bytes <= 2048. thoughts?

Tara: this could be nice for chat snippets. main worry: quota/accounting and mixed-dim clients accidentally sending header wrong. :thinking:

Ryan: agreed on perf. we need deterministic quota unit calculation so console reporting doesn't go bonkers. if we skip preflight, we still must emit the same preflight telemetry event (maybe sampled).

Suki: can we require content-type + dims header + single-array body shape? then fastpath rejects anything ambiguous. error message should instruct client to remove header to run through preflight.

Luis: quick example request shape so ops knows exact contract:
```
POST /v1/embeddings HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: application/json
X-Embed-Dims: 1536
{ "input": ["short sentence"] }
```
If we get an array-of-arrays or mixed lengths -> reject with 422 and guidance.

Janet: telemetry checklist: prefix/kvcache-hit, batch-size, computed-unit-cost, route-used=slim-fastpath, preflight-emitted=false/true. console needs a per-route breakout for billing reconciliation.

Tara: rollout plan idea: feature-flag canary per-tenant; start with internal tenants + 5 customers. also add an opt-out header for clients that prefer stability.

Oliver: for quota math, proposal: compute units = max(1, ceil(byte_size / 512)) * (dims / 512 rounded up). mirror existing charge formula so accounting aligns. Ryan ok with that?

Ryan: works but we must log original preflight-estimate in case we later compare. Add a delta metric (fastpath_estimate - preflight_estimate) to detect divergence.

Suki: what about mixed-dim bulk requests? should never be allowed on fastpath. we'll reject and fallback to normal route with a hint header: X-Fallback-Reason: mixed_dims.

Luis: console UX: show route used as a small badge on request inspector and expose a filter for 'slim-fastpath only' in the request log. also add an alert when fastpath rejection rate > 1% in a tenant window.

deploy-bot: canary toggle applied: flag=slim_fastpath, env=canary1, started_by=Oliver, ts=1709123489

Janet: one more ops note — make sure our aggregator doesn't dedupe fastpath preflight sample events from normal preflight events. we need distinct labels to avoid metric collisions.

Oliver: great. i'll write a short RFC with exact headers, rejection codes, unit formula, and rollout steps. will include a console widget spec. tagging @Tara @Ryan to review before I post to eng-plans.
